ui_bugs.issue: Delete confirmation buttons (Cancel/Delete) do NOT appear after clicking the delete button. The handleDeleteClick function should set showDeleteConfirm to true, but the state change is not triggering a re-render or the onClick handler is not firing.
ui_bugs.details: After clicking the delete button with force=True, the confirmation buttons [data-testid='drawer-delete-cancel-button'] and [data-testid='drawer-delete-confirm-button'] are not found in the DOM. The code in TicketDrawer.js (lines 230-258) shows correct conditional rendering based on showDeleteConfirm state, and the handleDeleteClick function (lines 56-59) correctly sets setShowDeleteConfirm(true). However, this state change is not causing the component to re-render with the confirmation buttons. This issue has persisted through iterations 1, 2, 3, and now 5.
